summary: Include machine and camera health in the /ready service-readiness payload. Adds an apphost ReadinessReporter app interface so app modules can contribute advisory status fields; mymatasan reports machine (host CPU/mem/disk: ok/warning/critical) and cameras (ok or 'degraded (N offline)') from the in-memory monitor state. Advisory only — the ready/not-ready verdict stays gated on db + cache. Updates the ReadyResponse OpenAPI schema (which was also missing cache)
compatibility: Shared /ready handler gains an optional reporter; apps that do not implement ReadinessReporter are unaffected. /ready now returns extra advisory fields (machine, cameras) for mymatasan but still 200/503 based only on db + cache.
